intended_consumer_purpose: Managed fleet sessions can resolve a provider/model/role into a typed, digested compatibility profile and context envelope. Profile projection artifacts are ready for Y0 rendering (deferred integration). Profile evaluation harness is ready for Y4 effectiveness measurement (deferred integration).

required_proof: 79 tests passing across models, registry, resolver, context envelope, tool dialect, session receipt, projection, and evaluation modules

alternative_rejected.option: Building profiles directly into providers/ package
alternative_rejected.rejection_evidence: Provider capability discovery must remain separate from harness compatibility

alternative_rejected.option: Implementing governance enforcement at profile level
alternative_rejected.rejection_evidence: Profiles shape but do not authorize; governance remains with Rig application services

implemented_capabilities: Profile model definitions with frozen Pydantic models
Built-in profile registry of 5 profiles with computed SHA256 profile digests
Profile resolution algorithm: provider family matching, model pattern regex matching, role matching, capability checking, scoring, and batch resolution
Tool dialect text adaptation with authority assertion
Profile resolution projection and desktop projection merge utility
Profile evaluation harness (5 checks per profile)
unimplemented_capabilities: Governance engine integration (authority_rule field is documentation, not enforcement)
Runtime harness compatibility verification against live provider APIs
Cryptographic receipt signing or Merkle chaining

tests_run.command: uv run ruff check rig_relay/profiles/ tests/profiles/

external_effects_not_executed: No file mutations (all profiles code is read-side)
No subprocess execution (git status uses pure-Python .git/HEAD read)
strongest_suspected_weakness: Profile resolution does not dynamically discover model capabilities from live provider APIs. The resolver relies on caller-provided model_capabilities or falls back to ignoring unknown capabilities. This means profile-to-model fit is only as good as the provided capability data.
proposed_reviewer_attack_surface: Profile selection dominance: verify that specific profiles can be selected when user prefers them
Capability check bypass: verify that empty or missing capability data is rejected when profile has requirements
Profile immutability: verify frozen models prevent runtime mutation
Authority assertion completeness: verify all forbidden authority patterns are detected in adapted descriptions
Digest integrity: verify profile digests change when profile content changes
Evaluation coverage: verify all roles × all providers × all profiles are tested
